record.question:
The ‘KALI’ (Kilo Ampere Linear Injector) project, often mentioned in discussions on advanced
    defence technologies in India, was originally developed by DRDO and BARC primarily as a:
options: Directed-energy laser weapon for battlefield deployment
High-power electron beam accelerator capable of generating intense microwave pulses
